title: Box Jellyfish Ki 24 Aankhon Ka Khaufnaak Sach! 🪼 #shorts
idea: Box jellyfish possess 24 eyes in four clusters, swim up to 7.4 km/h, and deliver lethal stings with 500,000 stinging cells per tentacle.

lines.text: Iss samundari jeev ke paas ek ya do nahi, poore 24 aankhein hain!
Box jellyfish ki ye aankhein char alag clusters mein bati hoti hain.
Ye normal jellyfish jaise behti nahi, 7 km/h ki speed se tairti hain!
Inke har tentacle mein lagbhag 5 lakh zaharile stinging cells hote hain!
Inka zahar itna khaufnaak hai ki cardiac arrest sirf 2 minute mein ho sakta hai!
Kya aap aise 24 aankhon wale shikari se samundar mein milna chahoge?

facts.claim: Box jellyfish have 24 eyes grouped into clusters.
They can swim at speeds around 7.4 km/h.
Each tentacle has about 500,000 stinging cells (cnidocytes).
Severe stings can cause cardiac arrest within two minutes.
